attchmntText: Artemis Electricals and Projects Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Artemis Electricals and Projects Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board met on November 13, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 1,262.10 Lakhs for the quarter and 2,880.59 Lakhs for the half year. Standalone profit before tax was 150.36 Lakhs for the quarter and 343.46 Lakhs for the half year. Standalone profit for the period was 112.53 Lakhs for the quarter and 243.72 Lakhs for the half year. The company is commissioning a Lithium-ion battery plant with Electroforce India Limited. Manufacturing activities are at a minimal level. The company focuses on projects. Total assets stood at 14,111.97 Lakhs as of September 30, 2026. Cash and cash equivalents were 1,866.22 Lakhs.
